newsitem.title: USA: Assets of money market funds rose in week.
newsitem.headline: Assets of money market funds rose in week.

text.p: Assets of the nation's retail money market mutual funds rose $2 billion to $587.09 billion in the week ended October 2, the Investment Company Institute, an industry trade group, said Thursday.
It said assets of the 407 taxable money market funds in the retail category rose $990.4 million to $478.89 billion, while assets of the 256 tax-exempt funds rose $1 billion to $108.20 billion.

The trade group said assets of the 307 institutional money market funds rose $6.99 billion to $269.28 billion. Of these, the 244 taxable money market fund assets grew $5.61 billion to $240.03 billion, and assets of the 63 tax exempt funds rose $1.37 billion to $29.25 billion.
Money market mutual fund assets stood at $856.37 billion in the week. Assets for the week ended September 25 were revised to $847.39 billion from $846.70 billion.
